title: Brussels proposes an autonomy dial for AI agents that shop on your behalf
summary: The European Commission's draft Digital Fairness Act, published on 11 November, would replace the 2005 unfair commercial practices directive with a regulation that applies directly across the bloc. Article 26 covers software that concludes contracts for a consumer and would require a first-use choice: approve every contract, approve only categories the consumer defines by criteria such as a price ceiling and a time limit, or let the agent buy unsupervised. Traders would have to provide tools to change that setting later.
